findings.title: Editor overlay vs hero hit-testing / pointer-events ownership unspecified
findings.where: docs/architecture.md (T1 editor, T3 page, T4 hit testing); src/shared/presentation.ts GridbornPage.editorCanvas
findings.repro: Per contract editorCanvas is a transparent overlay at the same size above heroCanvas; T4 owns car hit-testing/inspection; T1 editor attaches listeners to editorCanvas and setEnabled toggles it. Nothing states who sets pointer-events/touch-action on the overlay when drawing is disabled, or which canvas T4 listens on.
findings.impact: Likely integration bug: car clicks/taps captured by the overlay (inspection dead) or drawing and selection firing together. Specify: disabled editor sets overlay pointer-events:none (or T4 hit-tests on the overlay when not drawing).

findings.title: Pointer/touch interaction shows the keyboard focus ring
findings.repro: Click or tap the canvas: canvas matches :focus-visible and draws 3px blue outline (focus-font-probe.json; *-after-drag.png). Control tabindex div clicked normally does not.
findings.impact: Visual noise on every mouse/touch use; pattern should not be copied into T1/T4 surfaces (rely on native focus or focus({focusVisible:false})).

findings.title: DPR-only changes are not detected
findings.repro: CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride changing deviceScaleFactor 1/1.5/2/3 with same CSS size: no resize event, canvas.width stays at old value (e.g. 2144 at DPR 1). Next genuine resize corrects it. World position preserved.
findings.impact: Blurry or oversized backing store after moving a window between displays until a resize. Contract says backing store follows DPR but does not name a detection mechanism (matchMedia resolution listener or devicePixelContentBoxSize).
findings.limit: Headless emulation also did not fire a matchMedia change; real monitor-move behaviour not verified.

findings.title: Landscape 844x390: canvas starts below the fold and is mostly letterbox
findings.repro: Canvas top=388px in a 390px viewport (landscape-844x390-initial.png); after scrolling, 760x240 canvas uses ~288px width for the world (canvas-in-view.png).
findings.impact: Disposable shell only, but the final hero must plan landscape phones explicitly (T3/T4).

findings.title: --font-mono falls back to Courier in Chromium on macOS
findings.repro: CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode on <output> reports Courier; screenshots show serif mono readout and eyebrow.
findings.impact: Persisting token; looks unpolished in Chrome. Add ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo before Consolas.

findings.title: Failed reset leaves runId ownership ambiguous
findings.where: docs/architecture.md T2 run semantics 1-2; SimulationEvent error
findings.repro: Main sends reset runId N+1; worker validates, rejects, keeps run N and emits error(runId N+1). Main ignores stale (runId N) events, so the hero stalls unless the contract says main reverts to N or worker halts run N.
findings.impact: Edge case (validated geometry should not fail) but should be one sentence in the contract.

findings.title: Canvas <= 48 CSS px throws uncaught RangeError in rAF
findings.repro: Viewport width 80px -> canvas 40px -> pageerror View bounds and available CSS size must be finite and positive. (narrow-probe.json). 120px viewport fine.
findings.impact: Unrealistic size; draw() should share the place() guard. Pattern note for T4.

findings.title: Focusable interactive canvas uses role=img
findings.repro: canvas tabindex=0 role=img with arrow-key handling.
findings.impact: Screen readers present a static image; acceptable for a disposable check, revisit for editor/inspection surfaces (e.g. role=application or a labelled group with live output).
